definitions.explanation: A designated path for people to follow when evacuating a building or area during an emergency.

examples.japanese: {避難経路|ひなんけいろ}を{確認|かくにん}しておいてください。
examples.english: Please check the evacuation route in advance.

examples.japanese: {避難経路|ひなんけいろ}に{荷物|にもつ}を{置|お}かないでください。
examples.english: Please don't leave belongings in the evacuation route.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}に{備|そな}えて{避難経路|ひなんけいろ}を{家族|かぞく}で{話|はな}し{合|あ}った。
examples.english: We discussed evacuation routes as a family in preparation for earthquakes.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {避難|ひなん} (evacuation, taking refuge) + {経路|けいろ} (route, path).

CONTEXT: Important concept in Japan due to frequent natural disasters (earthquakes, typhoons, tsunamis).

RELATED SAFETY TERMS:
- {非常口|ひじょうぐち}: emergency exit
- {避難所|ひなんじょ}: evacuation shelter
- {避難訓練|ひなんくんれん}: evacuation drill
- {消火器|しょうかき}: fire extinguisher
- {誘導灯|ゆうどうとう}: emergency guide light

COMMON SIGNS:
- {避難経路|ひなんけいろ} (evacuation route)
- {避難経路|ひなんけいろ}{図|ず} (evacuation route map)
- この{通路|つうろ}は{避難経路|ひなんけいろ}です (This passage is an evacuation route)

COLLOCATIONS:
- {避難経路|ひなんけいろ}を{確保|かくほ}する (to secure an evacuation route)
- {避難経路|ひなんけいろ}を{確認|かくにん}する (to check the evacuation route)
- {避難経路|ひなんけいろ}に{従|したが}って{避難|ひなん}する (to evacuate following the route)
